description: Make Rust Core GA the immediate priority and defer lower-priority adapter expansion until release-candidate evidence exists.

included: Rust Core GA roadmap, priority freeze, and deferred-adapter governance.
Rust core, Python binding, C ABI, canonical, CLI/file, HTTP, MCP, and OpenAI surface contract foundations.
Focused Rust parity, Python parity, CI, and release-evidence scaffolding needed for release-candidate promotion.
Support-status guardrails that prevent unsupported streams from being inferred as GA.
excluded: Stakeholder approval, signed release artifacts, SBOM attestation, or registry publication.
Claiming every stream/year is Rust-default or Rust-GA.
Full local `cargo test --workspace` proof when `nwau-py` dynamic Python linkage is unavailable.

gap_register.description: Full release hardening, evidence bundle attachment, SBOM/provenance, rollback procedures, and GA promotion require real CI and stakeholder coordination.
Focused Rust core and parity validations pass, but full local workspace tests can be blocked by missing `libpython3.13.dylib` for `nwau-py`.
